packages.title: Pachmarhi Hill Retreat for Couples 3N/4D
packages.summary: Quiet hill station in the Satpura range, waterfalls and caves, Dhoopgarh sunset.
highlights: Quiet hill station in the Satpura range

itinerary.title: Bhopal – Pachmarhi
itinerary.description: Pickup at Bhopal and drive (about 5 hrs) through forest and farmland to Pachmarhi, the only hill station of Madhya Pradesh. Evening walk in the cantonment and the old church. Overnight stay in Pachmarhi.

itinerary.title: Pachmarhi Sightseeing – Caves & Falls
itinerary.description: Breakfast and a day among Pachmarhi's sights by local gypsy – the Pandav Caves, the Jata Shankar cave shrine, a dip at Bee Falls and the view from Priyadarshini Point. Overnight stay in Pachmarhi.

itinerary.title: Pachmarhi – Dhoopgarh Sunset
itinerary.description: Breakfast and visit Reechgarh rock formations, the pools of Apsara Vihar and the deep Handi Khoh gorge. End the day with sunset at Dhoopgarh, the highest point of the Satpura range. Overnight stay in Pachmarhi.

itinerary.title: Pachmarhi – Bhopal Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive back to Bhopal for your evening train or flight (or drop at Pipariya station, 1.5 hrs). Tour ends.

packages.title: Malwa Circuit – Indore, Mandu, Maheshwar, Omkareshwar & Ujjain 4N/5D
packages.summary: Mahakaleshwar and Omkareshwar Jyotirlingas, Mandu's palaces, Maheshwar on the Narmada.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Indore
itinerary.description: Pickup and check-in. Visit the Rajwada and Lal Bagh Palace; in the evening try Indore's famous street food at Sarafa Bazaar or Chhappan Dukan (own cost). Overnight stay in Indore.

itinerary.title: Indore – Mandu
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to the ruined hill city of Mandu (about 2.5 hrs). Explore the Jahaz Mahal, Hindola Mahal and Baz Bahadur's palace, and watch sunset from Rani Roopmati's pavilion. Overnight stay in Mandu.

itinerary.title: Mandu – Maheshwar
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Maheshwar on the Narmada (about 1.5 hrs). Visit Ahilya Fort and the ghats, see Maheshwari saree weavers at work and take a sunset boat on the river (own cost). Overnight stay in Maheshwar.

itinerary.title: Maheshwar – Omkareshwar – Ujjain
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Omkareshwar (about 1.5 hrs) for darshan of the Omkareshwar and Mamleshwar Jyotirlinga temples on the island in the Narmada. Continue to Ujjain (about 3 hrs). Overnight stay in Ujjain.

itinerary.title: Ujjain Darshan & Departure
itinerary.description: Early darshan at Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga (Bhasma Aarti needs separate advance booking), then Kal Bhairav, Harsiddhi Temple and Ram Ghat. Drive to Indore (about 1.5 hrs) for your departure. Tour ends.

packages.title: Kanha Tiger Safari with Bhedaghat Marble Rocks 5N/6D
packages.summary: Tigers and barasingha at Kanha, boat through the marble rocks of Bhedaghat.
highlights: boat through the marble rocks of Bhedaghat.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jabalpur
itinerary.description: Pickup and check-in. Visit the Madan Mahal fort and the Chausath Yogini Temple above the Narmada. Overnight stay in Jabalpur.

itinerary.title: Jabalpur – Kanha
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Kanha (about 4–5 hrs). Afternoon nature walk around the resort. Overnight at Kanha.

itinerary.title: Kanha Jungle Safaris
itinerary.description: Early-morning and afternoon jeep safaris into Kanha's meadows and sal forests – tiger, barasingha (hard-ground swamp deer), leopard and wild dogs (permits and gypsies at own cost). Overnight at Kanha.

itinerary.title: Kanha – Optional Safari & Village Walk
itinerary.description: Optional morning safari (own cost). Afternoon visit to a local Baiga or Gond village and the Kanha interpretation centre. Overnight at Kanha.

itinerary.title: Kanha – Bhedaghat – Jabalpur
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Bhedaghat (about 4 hrs). Boat ride through the white marble gorge of the Narmada (boating runs about October–June) and the Dhuandhar Falls (ropeway at own cost). Overnight stay in Jabalpur.

itinerary.title: Departure from Jabalpur
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drop at Jabalpur airport or railway station. Tour ends.

packages.title: Bhopal, Sanchi, Bhimbetka & Pachmarhi 5N/6D
packages.summary: Sanchi Stupa and Bhimbetka (UNESCO), Bhopal's lakes, Pachmarhi hills.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bhopal – City of Lakes
itinerary.description: Pickup and check-in. Visit the Taj-ul-Masajid, the Tribal Museum (closed Mondays) and spend sunset by the Upper Lake (Boat Club). Overnight stay in Bhopal.

itinerary.title: Sanchi & Udayagiri Day Trip
itinerary.description: Breakfast and day trip to Sanchi (about 1.5 hrs) for the Great Stupa and its carved gateways, then the Gupta-era Udayagiri caves. Return to Bhopal. Overnight stay in Bhopal.

itinerary.title: Bhojpur – Bhimbetka – Pachmarhi
itinerary.description: Breakfast and visit the unfinished Bhojeshwar temple with its huge Shivling at Bhojpur and the prehistoric rock paintings of Bhimbetka. Continue to Pachmarhi (about 4 hrs). Overnight stay in Pachmarhi.

itinerary.title: Pachmarhi Sightseeing – Caves & Falls
itinerary.description: Breakfast and a day among Pachmarhi's sights by local gypsy – the Pandav Caves, the Jata Shankar cave shrine, a dip at Bee Falls and the view from Priyadarshini Point. Overnight stay in Pachmarhi.

itinerary.title: Pachmarhi – Dhoopgarh Sunset
itinerary.description: Breakfast and visit Reechgarh rock formations, the pools of Apsara Vihar and the deep Handi Khoh gorge. End the day with sunset at Dhoopgarh, the highest point of the Satpura range. Overnight stay in Pachmarhi.

itinerary.title: Pachmarhi – Bhopal Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Bhopal for your departure (or drop at Pipariya station). Tour ends.

packages.title: MP Tiger Trail – Khajuraho, Panna, Bandhavgarh & Kanha 6N/7D
packages.summary: Three tiger reserves and the Khajuraho temples in one trip.
highlights: Three tiger reserves and the Khajuraho temples in one trip.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Khajuraho
itinerary.description: Pickup and check-in. Visit the Western Group of Temples (UNESCO) with their famous carvings, and the evening light & sound show (own cost). Overnight stay in Khajuraho.

itinerary.title: Panna National Park & Eastern Temples
itinerary.description: Morning jeep safari in Panna Tiger Reserve (own cost) or a boat on the Ken river. Afternoon at the Eastern and Jain temple groups. Overnight stay in Khajuraho.

itinerary.title: Khajuraho – Bandhavgarh
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Bandhavgarh (about 6 hrs). Evening at the resort. Overnight at Bandhavgarh.

itinerary.title: Bandhavgarh Safaris
itinerary.description: Early-morning and afternoon safaris in Bandhavgarh, known for one of the highest tiger densities in India (permits and gypsies at own cost). Overnight at Bandhavgarh.

itinerary.title: Bandhavgarh – Kanha
itinerary.description: Optional morning safari, then drive to Kanha (about 5–6 hrs). Overnight at Kanha.

itinerary.title: Kanha Safaris
itinerary.description: Morning and afternoon safaris in Kanha's meadows – tiger, barasingha, gaur and wild dogs (own cost). Overnight at Kanha.

itinerary.title: Kanha – Jabalpur Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and drive to Jabalpur (about 4–5 hrs) for your departure; a short stop at Bhedaghat marble rocks if time allows. Tour ends.
